definitions.explanation: The vertical distance from the surface of a body of water to its bottom. Used in geography, navigation, diving, and pool measurements.

examples.japanese: {水深|すいしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水深|すいしん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1.2⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧だ。
examples.english: The depth of this pool is 1.2 meters.

examples.japanese: {水深|すいしん}200⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦{届|とど}かなく→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Beyond a depth of 200 meters, sunlight barely reaches.

notes:
{水深|すいしん} refers to the depth of water — how deep a body of water is at a given point.

FORMS:
{水|すい} (water) + {深|しん} (depth). The same pattern appears in {海深|かいしん} (ocean depth).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水深|すいしん}〜⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧: depth of ~ meters
- {水深|すいしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧/⟦{浅|あさ}い→浅い：01274_asai⟧: deep/shallow water
- ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧{水深|すいしん}: maximum depth
- {水深|すいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure water depth

USAGE:
Used in maritime navigation, scuba diving, fishing, and geographic descriptions. Often appears on nautical charts and diving information.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{水位|すいい}→水位：21569_suii⟧: water level (height of water surface)
- ⟦{深海|しんかい}→深海：16050_shinkai⟧: deep sea
- ⟦{浅瀬|あさせ}→浅瀬：15720_asase⟧: shallows, shoal
